title.en: Module 10 Review A: Choose the Correct Word
title.zh: 第 10 单元复习 A：选对词

intro.en: Read the sentence. Say which word is correct. Then underline it on your paper. Main Book E1 helps.
intro.zh: 读句子，说出哪个词是对的，再在作业纸上划线。主课本 E1 可以帮你。

items.q: After we got to the beach, we discovered that Alani (all ready / already) knew how to surf.

why.en: Already = before now. All ready = everyone is ready.
why.zh: already = 已经。all ready = 全都准备好了。

items.q: My grandmother was certain that (somewhere / somewheres) in the attic was the trunk containing the old photographs.

why.en: There is no word "somewheres". Always write somewhere.
why.zh: 没有 somewheres 这个词，要写 somewhere。

items.q: No one (would have / would of) thrown the football to Floyd, because he had his hands in his pockets.

why.en: "Would of" only sounds like "would've". The correct words are would have.
why.zh: would of 只是听起来像 would've，正确写法是 would have。

items.q: The hidden gate lay in the valley (between / among) the ancient ruins and the pine forest.

why.en: Two things (the ruins and the forest), so between.
why.zh: 两样东西（废墟和森林），所以用 between。

items.q: You (had ought / ought) to see how wonderful the trees look when the leaves return after a long winter.

why.en: Never use "had" with ought. Write ought to.
why.zh: ought 前面不加 had，写 ought to。

items.q: Ronnie thought that the old house on the corner was (sort of / rather) mysterious.

why.en: In writing, use rather (or somewhat), not "sort of".
why.zh: 书面语用 rather，不用 sort of。

items.q: Luanne has a stronger crosscourt shot (then / than) I have.

why.en: Than compares two things (stronger than). Then is about time.
why.zh: than 用来比较（stronger than），then 表示时间。

items.q: The jury couldn't understand (how come / why) that man had committed the crime.

why.en: In writing, use why, not "how come".
why.zh: 书面语用 why，不用 how come。

items.q: If someone you didn't know offered you a million dollars for no reason at all, would you (accept / except) it?

why.en: Accept = take it and say yes. Except = but not.
why.zh: accept = 接受。except = 除了。

items.q: (Fewer / Less) people came to the play on Sunday afternoon than on Saturday night.

why.en: You can count people, so fewer.
why.zh: 人可以数，所以用 fewer。

items.q: Those beavers get so busy whenever they (try and / try to) build a dam.

why.en: Write try to, not "try and".
why.zh: 写 try to，不写 try and。

items.q: When the Brown family went for a boat ride down the Amazon, they didn't forget to (bring / take) along a big bottle of insect repellent.

why.en: They carried it AWAY from home, so take.
why.zh: 他们把东西从家里带走，所以用 take。

items.q: Oscar pointed to the newspaper story (where it / that) explained how the Blue Jays had won the game.

why.en: "Where" is for places. A story is not a place, so the story that explained.
why.zh: where 用于地点。故事不是地点，所以用 that。

items.q: If I get rid of my cold, I'll be (all right / allright).

why.en: All right is always two words.
why.zh: all right 永远是两个词。

items.q: Running red lights just (ain't / isn't) right.

why.en: "Ain't" is not used in correct writing. Use isn't.
why.zh: 正式写作不用 ain't，要用 isn't。

items.q: Columbus and his crew had to sail a long (way / ways) before they reached land.

why.en: Write a long way, not "a long ways".
why.zh: 写 a long way，不写 a long ways。

items.q: Nobody mentioned the incident that happened yesterday because it had already been discussed (a lot / alot).

why.en: A lot is always two words.
why.zh: a lot 永远是两个词。

items.q: Frannie and I looked at the map to find out (where the shortcut was / where the shortcut was at).

why.en: Do not add "at" after where.
why.zh: where 后面不要再加 at。

items.q: Mrs. Canares always (learns / teaches) her piano students the basics before she gets into the more difficult lessons.

why.en: The teacher teaches. The students learn.
why.zh: 老师 teach（教），学生 learn（学）。

items.q: Please (bring / take) me that game so that I may read the directions.

why.en: "Me" means toward the speaker, so bring.
why.zh: me 表示拿到说话人这里，所以用 bring。

title.en: Module 10 Review B: Proofread the Panda Paragraph
title.zh: 第 10 单元复习 B：校对熊猫段落

intro.en: Find the wrong word in each sentence. Cross it out and write the correct word on your paper. Main Book E2 helps.
intro.zh: 找出每句里用错的词，划掉，在纸上写出正确的词。主课本 E2 可以帮你。

items.q: [1] These pandas are certainly not you're ordinary bear.

why.en: You're = you are. "You are ordinary bear" makes no sense. Your = belongs to you.
why.zh: you're = you are，说不通。your = 你的。

items.q: [2] There native habitat is the wooded mountains of western China.

why.en: The habitat belongs to the pandas, so their.
why.zh: 栖息地属于熊猫，所以用 their（它们的）。

items.q: [3] For many years, this 355-pound black-and-white animal use to be considered a myth by most people outside China.

why.en: For the past, write used to: it used to be.
why.zh: 说过去常常，要写 used to。

items.q: [4] The panda can eat meat, but it's diet consists mainly of bamboo shoots and roots.

why.en: It's = it is. "It is diet" makes no sense. Its = belongs to it.
why.zh: it's = it is，说不通。its = 它的。

items.q: [5] A adult panda usually lives alone.

why.en: Adult starts with a vowel sound, so an adult.
why.zh: adult 以元音开头，所以用 an。

items.q: [6] Giant pandas can spend ten to twelve hours a day stuffing themselves with bamboo.
items.answer: Roy will check this sentence with you in class.

why.en: Read it slowly with Roy and look for a usage mistake together.
why.zh: 和 Roy 老师一起慢慢读，找找有没有用法错误。

items.q: [7] Their paws have a thumb that they use to strip the leaves off of the bamboo.

why.en: Write off, not "off of": strip the leaves off the bamboo. ("use to" is correct here: they use it to strip leaves.)
why.zh: 写 off，不写 off of。（这里 use to 是对的：用它来剥叶子。）

items.q: [8] This here thumb is the sixth "finger" they have on their paws.

why.en: Write this thumb, not "this here thumb".
why.zh: 写 this thumb，不写 this here thumb。

items.q: [9] A giant panda whose having cubs may take shelter in a cave or a hollow tree.

why.en: Who's = who is: a panda who is having cubs.
why.zh: who's = who is：正在生宝宝的熊猫。

items.q: [10] Giant pandas don't live in trees, but they can climb up them quite a ways when they need to escape from hunters.

why.en: Write quite a way, not "quite a ways".
why.zh: 写 quite a way，不写 quite a ways。

title.en: Module 10 Review C: Write a Winter Carnival Flyer
title.zh: 第 10 单元复习 C：写冬季嘉年华宣传单

intro.en: Plan first, then write your own flyer on paper. Main Book E3 helps.
intro.zh: 先计划，再在纸上写你自己的宣传单。主课本 E3 可以帮你。

items.q: What must your flyer include?
items.answer: The time, the date and the activities, plus at least 10 usage examples from Module 10, each one underlined.

why.en: The task asks for time, date and activities, and ten underlined usage examples.
why.zh: 题目要求写时间、日期、活动，并划出 10 个用法例子。

items.q: Plan it: fill in what, when, where and 3 activities.
items.answer:
What: Winter Carnival
When: Saturday 12 December, 10 am to 3 pm
Where: the school field
Activities: rides, games, an ice-sculpture contest

why.en: This is only an example plan. Use your own ideas.
why.zh: 这只是一个计划例子，要用你自己的想法。

items.q: Example flyer to learn from (write your OWN, do not copy).
items.answer: Our class is proud to announce that on Saturday 12 December it's holding a Winter Carnival. We hope that you and your family will come. There will be a lot of rides and games, and an ice-sculpture contest. Tickets cost less than last year, and fewer people will be in each line. You ought to come early. Bring your friends, and take home a prize! It will be all right if it rains, because there is a hall.

why.en: Usage words to underline here: it's, your, There, a lot, an, less than, fewer, ought to, Bring, take, all right.
why.zh: 这里要划线的用法词：it's、your、There、a lot、an、less than、fewer、ought to、Bring、take、all right。
